actual_times_in_order.name: actual_times_in_order
actual_times_in_order.value: (actual_arrival IS NULL) OR (actual_departure IS NULL) OR (actual_departure > actual_arrival)

contractor_documents_1099_year_check.name: contractor_documents_1099_year_check
contractor_documents_1099_year_check.value: kind <> '1099_nec' OR (tax_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100 AND reported_cents >= 0)

contractor_pay_rates_amount_check.name: contractor_pay_rates_amount_check
contractor_pay_rates_amount_check.value: (pay_type = 'day_rate' AND day_rate_cents > 0 AND day_rate_cents <= 1000000 AND percent_bp IS NULL) OR (pay_type = 'percent' AND percent_bp > 0 AND percent_bp <= 10000 AND day_rate_cents IS NULL)

customers_check.name: customers_check
customers_check.value: (first_name IS NOT NULL) OR (company_name IS NOT NULL)

inventory_items_amounts_check.name: inventory_items_amounts_check
inventory_items_amounts_check.value: vehicle_par >= 0 AND reorder_point >= 0 AND reorder_quantity >= 0 AND (unit_cost_cents IS NULL OR unit_cost_cents >= 0)

inventory_movements_places_check.name: inventory_movements_places_check
inventory_movements_places_check.value:
CASE kind
		WHEN 'purchase' THEN from_location_id IS NULL AND to_location_id IS NOT NULL
		WHEN 'transfer' THEN from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NOT NULL AND from_location_id <> to_location_id
		WHEN 'adjust' THEN (from_location_id IS NULL) <> (to_location_id IS NULL)
		ELSE from_location_id IS NOT NULL AND to_location_id IS NULL END

recurring_expenses_end_after_start_check.name: recurring_expenses_end_after_start_check
recurring_expenses_end_after_start_check.value: end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date

public.client_time_stats.definition: SELECT customer_code, client, property_id, count(*) AS visits, percentile_cont(0.5::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (onsite_min::double precision))::integer AS median_min, round(avg(onsite_min))::integer AS avg_min, min(onsite_min) AS min_min, max(onsite_min) AS max_min, max(visit_date) AS last_visit, round(sum(price_cents) FILTER (WHERE price_cents > 0)::numeric / 100.0 / NULLIF(sum(onsite_min) FILTER (WHERE price_cents > 0), 0)::numeric * 60::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_onsite_hr FROM visit_durations WHERE visit_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - 180) GROUP BY customer_code, client, property_id
public.client_time_stats.name: client_time_stats

public.data_issues.definition: SELECT 'no property'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, NULL::text AS detail FROM customers c WHERE c.status = 'active'::customer_status AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM properties p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id)) UNION ALL SELECT 'no service plan'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, p.street AS detail FROM properties p JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE p.is_active AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM service_plans sp WHERE sp.property_id = p.id AND sp.end_date IS NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT 'no primary phone'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, NULL::text AS detail FROM customers c WHERE c.status = 'active'::customer_status AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM contacts ct WHERE ct.customer_id = c.id AND ct.is_primary AND ct.phone IS NOT NULL)) UNION ALL SELECT 'shared phone'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, ct.phone AS detail FROM contacts ct JOIN customers c ON c.id = ct.customer_id WHERE (ct.phone IN ( SELECT contacts.phone FROM contacts WHERE contacts.phone IS NOT NULL GROUP BY contacts.phone HAVING count(DISTINCT contacts.customer_id) > 1)) UNION ALL SELECT 'shared address'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, p.street AS detail FROM properties p JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE (lower(p.street) IN ( SELECT lower(properties.street) AS lower FROM properties GROUP BY (lower(properties.street)) HAVING count(DISTINCT properties.customer_id) > 1)) UNION ALL SELECT 'visit priced $0'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, to_char((a.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text) AS detail FROM appointments a JOIN properties p ON p.id = a.property_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE a.status = 'completed'::text AND a.price_cents = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'odd duration'::text AS issue, visit_durations.customer_code, visit_durations.client, ((visit_durations.visit_date || ': '::text) || visit_durations.onsite_min) || ' min'::text AS detail FROM visit_durations WHERE visit_durations.onsite_min < 30 OR visit_durations.onsite_min > 360 UNION ALL SELECT 'double-booked day'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, to_char((a.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text) AS detail FROM appointments a JOIN properties p ON p.id = a.property_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE a.status <> 'cancelled'::text GROUP BY c.customer_code, (concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name)), a.property_id, (to_char((a.scheduled_start AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text), 'MM/DD/YYYY'::text)) HAVING count(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'active, no visit in 60 days'::text AS issue, c.customer_code, concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company_name) AS client, COALESCE('last: '::text || max((a.actual_arrival AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text)::date)::text, 'never'::text) AS detail FROM customers c LEFT JOIN properties p ON p.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.property_id = p.id AND a.status = 'completed'::text WHERE c.status = 'active'::customer_status GROUP BY c.id HAVING COALESCE(max(a.actual_arrival), '-infinity'::timestamp with time zone) < (now() - '60 days'::interval)
public.data_issues.name: data_issues

public.house_profitability.definition: SELECT s.customer_code, s.client, concat_ws(', '::text, p.street, p.city) AS address, p.zone, sp.frequency, round(sp.rate_cents::numeric / 100.0, 2) AS rate, s.visits, s.median_min, round(sp.rate_cents::numeric / 100.0 / NULLIF(s.median_min, 0)::numeric * 60::numeric, 2) AS revenue_per_hr, round(sp.rate_cents::numeric / 100.0 * CASE sp.frequency WHEN 'weekly'::frequency THEN 52::numeric / 12.0 WHEN 'biweekly'::frequency THEN 26::numeric / 12.0 WHEN 'every_4_weeks'::frequency THEN 13::numeric / 12.0 WHEN 'monthly'::frequency THEN 1::numeric WHEN 'every_2_months'::frequency THEN 0.5 ELSE 0::numeric END, 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM client_time_stats s JOIN properties p ON p.id = s.property_id JOIN service_plans sp ON sp.property_id = s.property_id AND sp.end_date IS NULL ORDER BY (round(sp.rate_cents::numeric / 100.0 / NULLIF(s.median_min, 0)::numeric * 60::numeric, 2)) DESC
public.house_profitability.name: house_profitability

public.monthly_revenue.definition: SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, paid_at) AS month, sum(amount_cents)::numeric / 100.0 AS revenue FROM payments GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, paid_at)) ORDER BY (date_trunc('month'::text, paid_at))
public.monthly_revenue.name: monthly_revenue

public.visit_durations.definition: SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, c.customer_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' '::text, c.first_name, c.last_name), ''::text), c.company_name) AS client, a.property_id, (a.actual_arrival AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'::text)::date AS visit_date, a.actual_arrival, a.actual_departure, round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM a.actual_departure - a.actual_arrival) / 60::numeric)::integer AS onsite_min, round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM a.actual_departure - a.actual_arrival) / 60::numeric * a.crew_size::numeric)::integer AS labor_min, a.crew, a.crew_size, a.price_cents, a.actual_source FROM appointments a JOIN properties p ON p.id = a.property_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE a.status = 'completed'::text AND a.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL AND a.actual_departure IS NOT NULL
public.visit_durations.name: visit_durations
